criteria.criterion: After every iteration's commit the driver rewrites `.vloop/state/metrics/<run id>.json` with the brief's `metrics/v1` (the same computation `vloop metrics --json` and B4's snapshot use, not a copy) and the next commit includes it; the run's closing commit includes the last snapshot, and the working tree is clean when the run ends
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/snapshot.go snapshot() calls metrics.Build via it.report() right after it.commit in iterate(); commit() calls writeSnapshot() before git add -A, so the next commit (incl. finish's closing commit) carries it; held in memory so the tree stays clean. Classifier body moved to metrics.NewClassifier and shared, not copied. TestRunSnapshot in cmd/vloop.

criteria.criterion: At the end of every run, whatever its ending (complete, blocked, stalled or halted), the driver prints the brief's `vloop metrics` summary on stdout
criteria.evidence: Iterator.Run calls it.summary() after finish for every Ending, using metrics.PrintSummary on it.Out; TestRunSummary covers a halted run. Early preflight/exit-9 returns skip it, noted by the work session, and are not run endings via finish.

criteria.criterion: An iteration whose record has `gate.flaky: true` yields exactly one derived defect `origin: env`, `kind: bug`, `found-by: gate`, and no work defect; an iteration without it yields none of these
criteria.evidence: internal/metrics/defects.go Derive appends one env/bug/gate Derived per it.Flaky; runs.readIterations reads gate.flaky; the flaky iteration's outcome is done, so the gate_failed work-defect branch does not fire. TestDerivedFlakyGate asserts count 1, fields, matrix env/gate=1 and work/gate=0, and none for the non-flaky iteration.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests: `TestRunSnapshot` and `TestRunSummary` in cmd/vloop (the summary also on a halted run), and a test in internal/metrics whose name contains `Flaky` covering a flaky and a non-flaky gate
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/run_snapshot_test.go has TestRunSnapshot, TestRunSummary (+TestRunSnapshotFlakyDefect); internal/metrics/defects_test.go TestDerivedFlakyGate covers both gate kinds.
